summary: Split the dashboard into six ordered fragments: header, health summary, models table, recent runs list, cost panel, and footer.

shared.style_guide: Plain black on white, only system fonts, no decorative elements, no icons, no emojis. All spacing uses the --fa-spacing variable. All colours use the defined CSS variables. Text is concise and factual.
shared.heading_levels: The page title uses <h1>. Section headings (if any) use <h2>.

components.purpose: Show a table of model details: alias, provider, median latency, and price per 1M tokens.
components.spec: Root element: <section class="fa-component" data-component="models-table">. Inside, a <table class="fa-models"> with <thead> containing a row of headings: Alias Provider Latency Price‑in Price‑out. <tbody> has two rows: "gpt-oss-120b Cerebras ~1 s $0.35 $0.75" and "mercury-3 Inception n/a $0.10 $0.35". Use <td class="fa-cell"> for each cell. Include a <style> that sets border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 0.9rem; and sets padding: var(--fa-spacing) on .fa-cell, and color: var(--fa-gray-2) on the header row.
interfaces: Provides table layout using CSS variables

components.purpose: List the five recent run entries with task, harness, steps, wall time, and result.
components.spec: Root element: <section class="fa-component" data-component="recent-runs">. Inside, a <ul class="fa-runs"> with five <li class="fa-run"> items exactly: "web-1 rig 4 3.1 s pass", "files-1 rig 3 2.2 s pass", "memory-1 langchain 5 4.8 s pass", "web-2 langchain 6 6.0 s pass", "swarm status-page-6 swarms-rs 7 2.8 s pass". Add a <style> that sets list-style: none; margin:0; padding:0; and margin‑bottom: var(--fa-spacing) on .fa-run.
